description: Nombre de journées d’absence des agents SNCF is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Nombre de journées d’absence des agents SNCF depuis 2010. Ces données intègrent toutes les absences de courte et longue durée, y compris celles ayant débuté au cours de l’exercice précédent pour la part se prolongeant sur l’exercice en cours. Ces données ne comptabilisent pas les congés annuels et congés de fin de carrière. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Social et ressources humaines. Its keywords are Social, Ressources humaines, Emploi, Direction Cohésion. The portal shows 2026-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
